subject: Linguistics
title: Subject, Verb, Object
description: A micro-lesson that makes Subject, Verb, Object usable.

hook.text: 'The cat chased the mouse.' Subject does the action, verb is the action, object receives it.

buildup.text: SVO is the default word order in English, French, and about 35 percent of languages.

discovery.text: SOV (subject-object-verb) is actually more common—used by Japanese, Korean, and Hindi.

twist.text: VSO order exists too—Irish and Arabic both put the verb first.

climax.text: Word order is one of the first things typologists check when classifying a language.

punchline.text: Three ingredients, six possible orders—languages choose.

quiz.question: Which word order is most common globally?
